text: 1. Cattāro 'me bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. Katame cattāro? Attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya, parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya, attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca, n'; ev'; attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 99.
